title: moduleTree
responsibility: Read module metadata at a project boundary without importing application code.

inputs.name: moduleTree.root
inputs.description: Directory used as the base for read(path) and list(); list() scans its specification/modules child. The implementation does not validate that it is absolute or that a package manifest exists.

outputs.name: moduleTree
outputs.type: { read: (path: string) => Promise<string>; list(): Promise<{ path: string; }[]>; }
outputs.description: An object with read(path) and list() methods bound to root. read reads the path formed by join(root, path) as UTF-8; list returns {path} records for immediate directories under specification/modules whose module.json reads succeed, returns an empty list for a missing module directory, omits missing module files, and propagates other filesystem errors.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Filesystem failures rejected by read() or thrown while list() scans directories or reads module files are propagated unless handled as ENOENT; a missing module directory yields an empty list, and a missing module file is omitted.
